Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the opening, add a brief image of the setting, such as “墓地旁边有很多石碑，风吹过的时候很安静。” This helps the reader picture the place.
2. At the sentence about going to the cemetery, add Mengzi’s reaction to make his actions more personal, such as “孟子觉得那里很神秘，也很好玩。”
3. You could show an interaction with his friends through a short line of speech, such as “他对朋友们说：‘我们去那边看看吧！’”

ideas.reason: It adds a concrete, plausible picture of the cemetery without changing the story.
It gives a simple feeling that fits a child finding the nearby cemetery interesting.
It adds a short, natural line of speech showing Mengzi playing with his friends.
